description: V0.5c development evaluation, Stage C (memory control: Stage B's seeds, 30 days, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with memory off; its memory-on runs are Stage B's) (docs/benchmark/v05c-dev/PLAN.md): the frozen LLM agent with local models beside the no-op baseline on the bundled sustainable scenario, daily decisions at 07:00.
